policy: User art selections and numeric star ratings are distinct and must not be conflated.
User-selected works KMSKA 403 and 314 are uniquely accession-matched to the acquired photograph; never show unrelated physical original as identical.
No new visual/artwork selection was made by automation.
Rights clearance and user selection remain independent from acquisition and mobile visual quality.
No minimum source resolution requirement; 344px and 397px phone-sized images can be adequate.
Modern saints may use authentic historical photographs; no need to force an oil painting.
No live app or ratings touched.
Excluded artists Fra Angelico and El Greco remain excluded.
